fact: ACP reported on 10 January 2021 that information on suspects and victims of offences recorded by judicial police officers across Kinshasa is encoded into a database by trained operators, and that the 52 Kinshasa commissariats are now able to feed the FCICAP file, with over 1,400 officers trained.
title: Renforcement du partenariat RDC-France sur le fichier criminel des infractions constatées en RDC
